summary: Iteration 3 e2e test (backend + frontend) for prulesoul.site live MVP — Emergent Google Auth, real GitHub sync, Reach Out persistence, About/Legal/Kids Universe pages, 18+ gate. Backend: 13/15 tests pass (87%) — auth 401 unauth/bad-bearer/invalid-session-id all correct, GitHub sync returns not_configured for empty repo and graceful error for nonexistent repo, Reach Out persists with correct destination_configured flag, regression endpoints (health, library, books, admin, validate) all healthy. Two backend failures: GET /api/content/entries?surface=brand and ?surface=legal both return 422 instead of 200 because the Surface Pydantic Literal type is still restricted to ['library','learning'] (see /app/backend/server.py line 91). Frontend: All 23 review-request UI checks pass — title contains 'prulesoul.site', footer has 'prulesoul.site · Matrix Aurin' + About + Legal · Responsibility, Guardian dock visible bottom-left, age gate appears on /learning then persists across /meditation-corner via localStorage, /kids-universe is NEVER gated, three age groups + coloring CTA render, Coloring Studio generates placeholder line-art, Portal shows sign-in button, Forget 18+ confirmation works (gate returns on /learning), About + Legal placeholders render, Reach Out form submission shows reach-out-sent confirmation, all regression routes (/, /library, /bookstore, /meditation-corner, /admin/content) render. The 422 error is visible in console on /about and /legal but the frontend's try/finally swallows it so placeholders still render — this becomes a real defect once GitHub content is configured because brand/legal entries will never be fetchable.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: /app/backend/server.py line 91 still defines `Surface = Literal['library','learning']` from earlier iterations. The new iteration's GitHub sync mapping (lines 415-422) introduces brand/legal/kids/meditations as legitimate surface values, and the frontend pages About.jsx/Legal.jsx query for them. FastAPI validates the query param against the Literal type and rejects with 422 before the handler runs. Reproduction: `curl 'BASE/api/content/entries?surface=brand'` → 422. Mitigation: widen the Literal to include all six surfaces. The frontend currently masks the bug because About/Legal use try { ... } finally { setLoading(false); } without logging — the placeholder always renders so to a user nothing looks broken, but real GitHub content will never display for /about or /legal.
